authorityExtensions.rule: F1 consumes the parent authority root, Todo 1 child root, Todo 3 verifier root, Todo 45 release manifest, and canonical evidence index tail; no final verifier may rewrite parent contracts or product authority.

finalVerifierIsolation.parallelReceipts: F2, F3 and F4 use separate Docker Compose project names, attempt directories, databases, CAS roots and advisory output files. They write attempt-local receipts only; F1 serially imports/indexes those receipts with the exclusive evidence writer.
finalVerifierIsolation.f3ColdStartRule: F3 may run docker compose down -v only with its own project name and state root. It must not delete F2/F4 state, shared .omo artifacts, or the default developer project.
finalVerifierIsolation.browserIdentityRule: F3 records the Playwright-launched browser executable path, product version and CDP Browser.getVersion output and fails unless the launched browser is Chrome 151.0.7922.138.
